cards.name: Bilbo Baggins
cards.text: The first player gains control of Bilbo Baggins. Bilbo Baggins cannot gain resources from player card effects. If Bilbo Baggins leaves play, the players lose the game.

cards.name: A Short Rest
cards.text: Setup: Shuffle the Over the Misty Mountains Grim and Western Lands encounter sets into one encounter deck and make it the active encounter deck. Then, shuffle the The Great Goblin and Misty Mountain Goblins encounter sets into a second encounter deck and set it aside, inactive.
cards.back_text: When Revealed: Each player may search his deck for 1 treasure card and add it to his hand, then shuffle his deck. Advance to stage 2A.

cards.name: A Suspicious Crow
cards.text: When Revealed: Reveal the top card of the encounter discard pile and add it to the staging area, if able.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If this attack deals at least 1 damage, shuffle this card back into the encounter deck.

cards.name: Cave Entrance
cards.text: While Cave Entrance is in the staging area, it gains: "Forced: At the end of the round, place the top X cards of the encounter discard pile on the bottom of the encounter deck. X is the number of players in the game."

cards.name: Chaos in the Cavern
cards.text: When Revealed: All engaged enemies return to the staging area. Then, each Goblin enemy gets +1 [threat] until the end of the phase.
cards.shadow: Shadow: attacking enemy is returned to the staging area after its attack resolves.

cards.name: Down, Down to Goblin Town
cards.text: When Revealed: Shuffle all encounter cards back into the encounter deck and set it aside, inactive. The second encounter deck becomes the active encounter deck. Search the encounter deck for The Great Goblin and add it to the staging area. Then, shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.back_text: Players cannot defeat this stage unless The Great Goblin is in the victory display.  When Revealed: Reveal 3 encounter cards per player. Bilbo Baggins may spend X resources to reduce the total number of encounter cards revealed by X. (To a minimum of 1.)  If the players defeat this stage, they have won the game.

cards.name: Dreary Hills
cards.text: Forced: After placing 1 or more progress tokens on Dreary Hills, each player must discard 1 card at random from his hand.  Response: After Dreary Hills leaves play as an explored location, Bilbo Baggins gains 1 resource.

cards.name: Front Porch
cards.text: While Front Porch is the active location, players cannot attack Goblin enemies.  Action: The first player may spend 2 [baggins] resources to treat Front Porch's printed text box as if it were blank until the end of the round.

cards.name: Galloping Boulders
cards.text: When Revealed: The first player chooses a questing character. That character takes 3 damage and is removed from the quest.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Put this card on top of the encounter deck.

cards.name: Goblin Axeman
cards.text: Goblin Axeman gets +1 [attack] for each Cave location in play.

cards.name: Goblin Bent-Swords
cards.text: If The Great Goblin is in the victory display, this card gains surge.
cards.shadow: Shadow: attacking enemy gets +1 [attack]. (+2 [attack] instead if The Great Goblin is in the victory display.)

cards.name: Goblin Driver
cards.text: When Revealed: The first player exhausts 1 character he controls.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending player exhausts 1 character he controls.

cards.name: Goblin Miners
cards.text: Goblin Miners gets +1 [defense] for each Cave location in play.

cards.name: Goblin Runners
cards.text: Surge.
cards.shadow: Shadow: attacking enemy makes an additional attack immediately after this one. (Deal a new shadow card for that attack.)

cards.name: Great Cavern Room
cards.text: While Great Cavern Room is the active location, it gains: "Forced: After a player engages a Goblin enemy, he must deal 1 damage to a character he controls."  Forced: When faced with the option to travel, if The Great Goblin is in the victory display the players must travel to Great Cavern Room if able.

cards.name: Grip, grab! Pinch, nab!
cards.text: When Revealed: Starting with the first player, each player must choose 1 Goblin enemy from the discard pile and add it to the staging area.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending player deals damage among characters he controls equal to the number of Goblin enemies engaged with him.

cards.name: Guffawing of Giants
cards.text: When Revealed: The first player chooses 1 Stone-giant in the staging area. At the end of the quest phase, that Stone-giant engages the player with the highest threat. If there are no Stone-giant cards in the staging area, search the encounter deck for 1 Stone-giant and add it to the staging area.

cards.name: Lone-Lands
cards.text: Forced: After placing 1 or more progress tokens on Lone-Lands, each player removes 1 resource from one of his hero's resource pools, if able.  Response: After Lone-Lands leaves play as an explored location, Bilbo Baggins gains 1 resource.

cards.name: More Like a Grocer
cards.text: When Revealed: Discard all [baggins] resources.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Resolve this card's "When Revealed" effect.

cards.name: No Campfire
cards.text:
Doomed 1.
When Revealed: Each player must choose one: increase his threat by 4, or reveal an additional encounter card from the encounter deck and add it to the staging area.
cards.shadow: Shadow: The defending player raises his threat by 2.

cards.name: Overhanging Rock
cards.text: While Overhanging Rock is the active location, it gains: "Action: Spend 1 [baggins] resource to look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Add 1 of those to your hand and discard the other."

cards.name: Stone-Giant
cards.text: While at least one Stone-Giant is in the staging area, the Galloping Boulders card gains surge.  Forced: After Stone-Giant engages a player, that player chooses and discards 1 ally he controls.

cards.name: The Goblins' Caves
cards.text: While The Goblins' Caves is the active location, Goblin enemies get +1 [threat].
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending player raises his threat by X. X is the number of Goblin enemies engaged with him.

cards.name: The Great Goblin
cards.text: Forced: After The Great Goblin attacks, discard X cards from the encounter deck where X is the number of players in the game. Add each Goblin enemy discarded by this effect to the staging area.

cards.name: The High Pass
cards.text: X is the number of players in the game.  Forced: At the end of the round, remove X progress tokens from the current quest.

cards.name: The Mountain Pass
cards.back_text: When Revealed: Search the encounter deck for 1 copy of Stone-giant and add it to the staging area. Then, shuffle the encounter deck. Reveal 1 card per player from the encounter deck and add it to the staging area.

cards.name: Wind-whipped Rain
cards.text: When Revealed: Discard all non-treasure, non-objective attachments in play.
